description.en: Rsync-based synchronization with dry run and report
description.de: Rsync-basierte Synchronisation mit Dry-Run und Report

instructions: Synchronisiere Verzeichnisse mit rsync. Variablen: source, target, exclude_patterns (kommasepariert), delete_removed (true/false).

config.command:
set -euo pipefail
SOURCE="{{ source }}"
TARGET="{{ target }}"
EXCLUDE="{{ exclude_patterns }}"
DELETE="{{ delete_removed }}"
echo "=== Dry Run ==="
CMD="rsync -avhn"
if [ "$DELETE" = "true" ]; then CMD="$CMD --delete"; fi
for pat in $(echo "$EXCLUDE" | tr ',' ' '); do
  CMD="$CMD --exclude=$pat"
done
$CMD "$SOURCE" "$TARGET" 2>&1

set -euo pipefail
SOURCE="{{ source }}"
TARGET="{{ target }}"
EXCLUDE="{{ exclude_patterns }}"
DELETE="{{ delete_removed }}"
echo "=== Executing Sync ==="
CMD="rsync -avh --stats"
if [ "$DELETE" = "true" ]; then CMD="$CMD --delete"; fi
for pat in $(echo "$EXCLUDE" | tr ',' ' '); do
  CMD="$CMD --exclude=$pat"
done
$CMD "$SOURCE" "$TARGET" 2>&1

set -euo pipefail
echo "# Sync Report"
echo "Generated: $(date -Iseconds)"
echo "Source: {{ source }}"
echo "Target: {{ target }}"
echo "Delete removed: {{ delete_removed }}"
echo "Exclude: {{ exclude_patterns }}"
echo ""
echo "## Source"
du -sh "{{ source }}" 2>/dev/null || true
echo ""
echo "## Target"
du -sh "{{ target }}" 2>/dev/null || true
